art_note: Clean, sophisticated studio lighting and sharp details establish a high-end luxury aesthetic.
desc_en: Redefining casual codes with a refined silhouette. Crafted from high-quality cotton with a soft and lightweight finish. Designed with a pre-curved visor and subtle embroidered details. Finished with an adjustable metal closure at the back to ensure effortless comfort. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Redefiniendo los códigos casuales con una silueta depurada. Confeccionada en algodón de alta calidad con un acabado suave y ligero. Incorpora una visera precurvada y detalles bordados discretos. Equipada con un cierre metálico ajustable en la parte posterior para asegurar una comodidad impecable. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío mundial.
